en.headline: Government strongly rejects joint statement by 10 countries on Wong case
en.dek: The HKSAR Government said the statement by the US, UK, France and seven other nations distorted facts and interfered in judicial independence regarding Joshua Wong's sentencing.
body: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government on Saturday issued a strong rebuttal to a joint statement by the governments of the United States, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Japan, Italy, Australia, Canada, the Netherlands and New Zealand concerning the sentencing of Joshua Wong Chi-fung.

A government spokesman said the statement disregarded facts, openly interfered with the SAR's exercise of judicial power and independent adjudication, and maliciously smeared the Hong Kong National Security Law. The government urged the countries concerned to immediately stop interfering in Hong Kong affairs, which are China's internal affairs.

Wong had pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit collusion with foreign countries or external elements to endanger national security under the National Security Law. The spokesman said the court had sentenced him independently and impartially in accordance with the law and the evidence, demonstrating the rule of law in Hong Kong. The government called on the countries to stop making irresponsible and misleading remarks.

zh.headline: 特區政府嚴正反駁十國就黃之鋒案聯合聲明
zh.dek: 特區政府指美、英、法及另外七國的聲明刻意歪曲事實及干預司法獨立，強烈不滿並堅決反對。
body: 香港特區政府今日（7日）發表嚴正聲明，對美國、英國、法國、德國、日本、意大利、澳洲、加拿大、荷蘭及新西蘭十國政府就「黃之鋒串謀勾結案」判刑發表的所謂聯合聲明，表示強烈不滿和堅決反對。
特區政府發言人指出，有關聲明罔顧事實、公然干預特區依法行使的司法權和獨立審判權，並惡意詞毁《香港國安法》。特區政府強烈敦促有關國家立即停止干涉屬中國內政的香港事務。
發言人表示，黃之鋒已承認觸犯《香港國安法》下「串謀勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全罪」，特區法院嚴格按照法律規定和司法程序，根據客觀事實及充分證據，獨立、公正地作出判刑，充分體現香港法治精神。特區政府敦促有關國家停止發表不負責任及具誤導性的言論。
